description: Read the canonical Delx Wellness profile shared with the other wellness MCP connectors (Nourish, Cycle Coach, CGM, etc.). Read-only. Profile stores only what the user typed during onboarding — never OAuth tokens, API keys, or biomarkers. Note: this profile does NOT change Strava's GPS-redaction default; Strava continues to redact latlng and route geometry unless STRAVA_GPS_INCLUDE=true or include_gps=true is explicitly passed.
name: strava_profile_get
title: Get Shared Wellness Profile
